# Main CPU base

Decoded main offset 0 runs at 0x60021020.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x60021020` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

Runtime addresses are decoded main plus 0x60021020. Some code and data are copied again at startup, so the flat image is not always what runs.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): The decoded main uses analysis base 0x60021020. Source: [PEN-F address spaces and loaded sections](../sources/fishcu.pen-f-spaces.md).
- **Emulator** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): Connected replay enters the main at 0x60021020. Source: [PEN-F startup function and service map](../sources/fishcu.pen-f-functions.md).
